existing_mapping.evidence: The ParkingLot class contains attributes for storing a unique ID, name, address, and city.
The Administrator class has a method to update parking lot details.
ParkingLot class holds an attribute to track the number of available spaces.
The ParkWiseSystem class is associated with the GateSensor class for vehicle data entry and exit detection.
ParkWiseSystem class method processEntry utilizes gate sensor data for vehicle identification.
ParkWiseSystem instructs the GateSensor to open the barrier if vehicle entry is validated.
System provides client instructions if vehicle entry is not automatically granted.
Client class has methods to provide personal and vehicle details including photos.
The ParkWiseSystem class extracts vehicle details from photos for vehicle registration.
Vehicle color is categorized into predefined groups as defined in the Color enum.
The system updates vehicle-client associations ensuring each vehicle maps to one client.
The system instructs the GateSensor to open the barrier after updates.
ParkingSession class records details including the start time and vehicle information.
Client is required to move the vehicle to a conveyor and secure it there.
ConveyorController scans vehicle numbers and assigns conveyors, requesting an optimization algorithm.
Locations for both ParkingSpace and Conveyor are described using floor number and coordinates.
ParkingSpace size is indicated to determine vehicle accommodation capabilities.
Conveyor includes a maximum weight capacity for vehicle transport.
Optimization algorithms consider parking space size and conveyor weight limits.
ConveyorController updates the system with final vehicle locations after completing movement to parking spaces.
The relationship between Vehicle and Location helps keep track of the vehicle's current location.
ParkWiseSystem is capable of sending SMS messages to clients with parking details.
System UI allows clients to access their parking details by entering their phone number.
Conveyor information is not retained at the end of the parking session as indicated by not storing past conveyors.
The endParking method in ParkWiseSystem handles vehicle retrieval requests from clients.
Vacant conveyors are utilized by ConveyorController to bring back the vehicle to the gate.
ParkWiseSystem requests client payment through the UI.
Price lists for parking are imported annually from the IRS in ParkWiseSystem.
Each ParkingLot can maintain different price lists for services.
The system maintains a history of price lists as shown by ParkingLot's aggregation with PriceList.
External PaymentGateway is used for processing payments, as associated with ParkWiseSystem.
Post payment approval, ParkWiseSystem issues instructions to GateSensor to open the gate.
Client can request receipts through the Client class in line with their transactions.
Receipts generated contain detailed information such as the client, vehicle, and pricing.
ClubMember class exists to manage club-related client functionalities.
PaymentGateway applies discount automatically for ClubMember sessions.
Clients can register for club membership through Client class functionality.
Membership attributes indicate free lifetime status for ClubMember.
ClubMember can select and store preferred parking lot selections with audit tracking.
ClubMembers get one free parking session applicable during their registration month at preferred lots.
Administrator class can generate various reports including financial summaries.
Annual report summarizes overall income from all parking lots.
Annual reports include parking lot payments and vehicle demographic data.
Data for reports is ordered by city and total amounts to facilitate analysis.
Reports can be exported in multiple formats, as indicated by ReportFormat.
The system supports generating monthly reports for club membership statistics.
The growth report reflects statistics such as joining members and percentage changes.
Monthly growth reports are chronologically ordered to show trends.
